name: Isaac Sim Lite
postStartCommand: bash -c 'mkdir -p /opt/isaac_pkgs && REQ_FILE=/work/requirements.in && HASH_FILE=/opt/isaac_pkgs/.reqs.sha && NEW_HASH=$(sha256sum $REQ_FILE | awk "{print \$1}") && OLD_HASH=$(cat $HASH_FILE 2>/dev/null || echo "none") && if [ "$NEW_HASH" != "$OLD_HASH" ]; then echo "📦 Detected dependency change. Installing..." && /isaac-sim/python.sh -m pip install --no-cache-dir --target /opt/isaac_pkgs -r $REQ_FILE && echo "$NEW_HASH" > $HASH_FILE && echo "✅ Install Complete."; else echo "⚡ dependencies up-to-date."; fi'
